description: This file defines the AuthorizationSubject interface in the org.eclipse.ditto.model.base.auth package. It specifies methods for creating new authorization subjects and retrieving their identifiers, serving as a core part of the authorization model within the project.

classes.name: AuthorizationSubject
classes.description: An interface representing an entity that is subject of authorization in Ditto, such as a user name.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new immutable AuthorizationSubject with the specified identifier.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Retrieves the identifier of this authorization subject.
